title: Fox and Moon Music in the Film
heading: The music in the film
lede: The whole radio cut three ways, with D2 (hedgerow folk and strings) cut into the three places the plan gives it: the pond and the ease, the rest, and the return. Switch between them as it plays; the place is kept.
notes: On the phone's own speaker. Once straight through in B, once in C, then use the jumps and switch between A, B and C at each place.
Everywhere else the three are the same. Tom is identical in all of them, and under his voice the music sits at least 18 LU down.
In the rest the phrase is stopped on purpose before "But when he stayed quiet", and at the return before "Halfway through". The last line, the hold and the black have no music.
The picture and the sound effects aren't in it yet.
